new_today_news.headline: India Turns Kitchen Grease to Fuel in Drive to Cut Crude Imports
new_today_news.summary: India is expanding kitchen waste into biofuels to reduce its crude import bill, with state-owned energy majors pursuing used cooking oil as an alternative feedstock. The report explores how this circular economy initiative mirrors global trends in FOG recycling and sustainable fuel production.

new_today_news.headline: Darling Ingredients Inc. Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results
new_today_news.summary: Darling Ingredients reported Q3 2026 results with Combined Adjusted EBITDA of $514.3M, including $171M in cash distributions from Diamond Green Diesel joint venture. DGD sold 314.9M gallons of renewable fuels in Q3 and 936.1M gallons year-to-date, with $1.30 per gallon adjusted EBITDA.

new_today_news.headline: GFL Environmental Inc. Reports Third-Quarter 2026 Results and Raises 2026 Guidance
new_today_news.summary: GFL Environmental raised FY2026 revenue guidance to $8,055-$8,075 million from $7,510-$7,530 million and adjusted EBITDA guidance to $2,490-$2,495 million from $2,290 million. Adjusted Free Cash Flow was $484.9 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, compared to $331.3 million for the same period in 2025.

recent_news.headline: Elevating Kitchen Compliance With Grease Trap Cleaning Services
recent_news.summary: Article discusses municipal regulatory standards for grease trap maintenance and the $4.2 billion global market for grease trap cleaning services. Highlights inspection requirements and professional upkeep to extend interceptor lifespan.

recent_news.headline: Grease Trap Maintenance for Restaurants: Schedule and Records
recent_news.summary: Practical guide covering grease trap maintenance, pumping schedules, municipal expectations, and record-keeping. Notes that large external interceptors typically require licensed contractors with vacuum trucks.
